test.title: A building in your country that you find interesting

document.cue: Describe a building in your country that you find interesting.

text: The building I find most interesting in Kazakhstan is Khan Shatyr, a huge shopping and entertainment centre in Astana, our capital.

What makes it unusual is its shape. It's designed to look like a giant tent, a bit like a traditional nomadic dwelling, and the top of it leans slightly to one side, so it looks different from every angle. The walls are made of a special transparent material rather than glass, and at night it's lit up in different colours, so you can see it from all over the city.

I visited it for the first time in January, when it was about minus thirty outside. The contrast was incredible: inside, it felt like early summer, with palm trees, cafés and even an indoor beach on the top floor, supposedly with sand brought all the way from the Maldives.

The reason I find it so fascinating is that it's a clever answer to Astana's climate. The winters there are brutal, so people need somewhere warm and bright to spend time, and the building's material lets in sunlight while keeping the heat inside. It's also interesting that such a modern structure is based on a very old idea.
Not everyone likes it — some people think it's just an expensive mall — but for me it shows how architecture can mix tradition with technology.

tips.en: The contrast was incredible — freezing outside, summer inside.
tips.kk: The contrast was incredible — сыртта аяз, ішінде жаз.
tips.ru: The contrast was incredible — холод снаружи и лето внутри.

tips.en: Supposedly shows the speaker is repeating a claim, not a checked fact.
tips.kk: Supposedly — сөйлеуші естігенін нақты дерек ретінде бермейді.
tips.ru: Supposedly — говорящий не выдаёт слух за точный факт.
tips.example: supposedly with sand brought all the way from the Maldives

note.en: What and where in the first sentence, explained for a foreign listener.
note.kk: Не және қайда — бірінші сөйлемде, шетелдікке түсіндірмемен.
note.ru: Что и где — в первой фразе, с пояснением для иностранца.

note.en: “What it looks like” — shape, material and lights, in order.
note.ru: «Как выглядит» — форма, материал, подсветка, по порядку.

note.en: A personal visit with the contrast of minus thirty and “summer” inside.
note.kk: Жеке сапар және қарама-қайшылық: сыртта минус отыз, ішінде «жаз».
note.ru: Личный визит с контрастом: минус тридцать снаружи и «лето» внутри.

note.en: Why it is interesting — what the building does and its link to an old idea.
note.kk: Неге қызық — ғимараттың қызметі және ескі идеямен байланысы.
note.ru: Почему интересно — функция здания и связь со старой идеей.
